text: Tapas were incredibly overpriced and the drinks were weak with small pours for being as expensive as they were. We got the bacon wrapped dates and they were shriveled and burnt and we got the tuna appetizer and it wasn't enough to feed a bird but still cost $16! Don't even waste your time getting the stuffed peppers (which is really only one pepper)! Was really hoping for better. Staff was great, ambience was great, but not a great dining experience.
It says open 24/7 on here. We went there at 10am and the lady said there were not open yet. We always eat here whenever we come to Reno so I was kinda disappointed.

I had the quiche and it was very good . My husband had the chicken pot pie is was just okay. The apple pie was served cold. And we are from the south where it is served warm. So, we didn't really like it. But! The peanut butter pie was really good. We probably will not return.

Jermaine  southward 
was my server very great fast and accurate service i recommend everybody come in to this dennys in avon and ask for him and see how wonderful your expirience is

Not sure how this place has high ratings. Walking in through the back lot you are greeted with a toilet sewer smell. It's so potent it almost was enough for us to loose our appetite. 

We sat ourselves- per the sign. We were given menus and it took about 5 minutes for someone to take our order. 

I ordered the menudo. A Sunday morning staple.  I tasted the broth and I want to say it tasted almost canned. There was no flavor, no spice. Super bland. Soup was lukewarm. 

They used lemons instead of limes. A little odd. 

The pancakes were tough to cut through. Nothing special   They are pancakes. Server came to check on us once. 
All in all. This place is lackluster and food is nothing special. 

Tried it but not for me.
Overrated, expensive and few choices. Not like the one in New Orleans the one on the Westbank is  not very good

What the heck happened to customer service? I mean we got in quickly, food was served hot, but bland. The BIG meatball is like a huge breadcrumb with a sprinkle of meat and seasoning. The best thing about any Olive Garden,(from my previous experiences) has been the interaction/conservations with your waiter/waitress. I miss how passionate people were about food and wine. We had more interaction with the iPad....

Great service, great experience, and a lovely brunch! The atmosphere here is peaceful and awesome. I may have found our new Sunday brunch place!! Watching the snow blow as we sat inside and ate.....priceless.

Went there to celebrate my friends birthday and it was a great choice! We promptly got a table and our waitress was on top of it. we had the November special margarita, which was cranberry. It was delicious, it was flavorful without being too sweet and didn't have any artificial flavor. Most of us designed our own tacos and everyone was satisfied!

When I think of Center City happy hour - especially in the warmer months of the year - I think of sipping cocktails, champagne, and bitter beers with friends at high tops near open windows, while slugging back plates of oysters, here on Sansom Street. 

Happy hours were always bustling and busy. Never a dull night, it was always good to a bit early. The oyster crackers were somehow always a highlight for me, filling an oversized goblet on the table, and refilled as often as you ask them to (I always did.)

Because it was busy, service could often be slow, but they are definitely training their servers pretty well; I never recall being left underserved, though it's best to arrive with a laid-back attitude and schedule following, because it might take a while to get seated and get your drinks & snacks. 

The food here is fresh and high-quality, and when it comes to seafood, that is exactly what you want!

Don't recommend coming here for the food. Absolutely horrible hamburgers and fries.  The hamburger didn't even taste like beef. Super loud. Couldn't even hear what our server was saying let alone carry on a conversation at the table.
This was well worth the wait!  Perfect biscuits, perfectly seasoned and cooked chicken....one of our best experiences while in Franklin!

Amazing place! This is our second time there. The sweets are extraordinary and the coffee- absolutely delicious. The owner is extremely nice and made us feel very welcome. We'll keep going, because we want to support great businesses like this one.
This location uses Doordash drivers for delivery. The driver spent over 15 minutes parked in one location and the food was worthless. Doordash would not take responsibility, nor would Red Robin.

Our waiter was very rude, didn't have any manners towards customer. We waited 30 so minutes to get our food and everyone who arrived after us got there food before us and when we asked why our food took so long she tried telling us because everyone else got there before us and was just very rude throughout the whole night. I wouldn't recommend coming to this location.
Our first time to try this restaurant. It was very good and we'll be back when we come back to Phili.

Very good, everyone is so friendly at this location, never messes up an order! Goes above and beyond to make the consumer happy. I asked the cashier if I could yell "2 PATTIES" and she was nice enough to allow it. After receiving my order Johnny (I believe was his name) make sure I had everything I needed and seemed to be very sincere when telling me to have a good day, instead of just saying the words. Also had a big friendly smile on his face. Everyone there makes me feel like they wouldn't want to be anywhere else :)

My husband and I were very disappointed 
My husband is Italian and we haven't been there in a while. I had lasagna way to much sauce.. not 
In pressed with the food .

2 burgers, 1 chix sandwich, 1 order of fries, a piece of toast with avocado and a smoothie -- $51!!!  $51 dollars folks for very small portions and bland! Do not eat at this place unless you really like throwing money away on bad food!
I recommend this place. I ate octopus. This is sauce and properly baked octopus gave me a very good smell. And the cocktail is a smoke show, and the smell of smoke remains in your mouth

Updating the review to 4 stars. I think I just went on an off night when they first opened. Went back again over the weekend, and found the food taste and quality to be better. 

I like this pace for the convenience factor. It's an easy and fast place that my friends and I can get to. The service here is good, and the food is pretty decent. I recommend definitely getting the shrimp, and the green mussels.

I ruined my meatball recipe & need a tray of balls for a 6 PM dinner party tonight-- one hour notice!

The guys waived their 24 hr notice & agreed to make me a half tray of their delicious meatballs (or a full tray, if I wanted it). They even tossed in a free bag of garlic knots! 

Now that's EXCELLENT service!

Update to the update: Lol. For $45, the meatballs were a smash hit. Everyone raved about the fresh sauce & velvety meat!

First time eating here and was truly disappointed.
Carly the Bartender was great!
Food left a lot to be desired.
Had the Caprese salad as a starter and it came with absolutely no rocket greens.
My girlfriend ordered wings which was not on the menu and she said that they were really good.
Ordered the bucatini pasta with pomodoro sauce.
Pasta was overcooked and the sauce resembled somewhat like the consistency of a chili; thick and overcooked. Ordered peas as a side which when delivered tasted like little lumps of charcoal.
It's a shame that you can call yourself an "Italian" restaurant and not even come close to pulling it off.
Sorry to say I will not be back!

Tucson is lucky to have this gem, right outside of Davis Monthan AFB. It has a cult following, you cannot find a better classic Hawaiian plate lunch in this state. I'm convinced of that because we went to Maui recently and some of the most hyped up plate lunch restaurants there weren't as good as Solid Grindz. The staff is awesome and prices are great. The Kalua Pork and Teri chicken with the Mac salad are my fav!

Fried chicken on a whole new level. Ooooooo!

I ordered chicken hot. Yup, it was, hot, big and just delicious! Had a local red ale with it, nice! Mac & cheese and some baked beans on the side and my tummy was happy! Black eyed peas are unique and something to tell friends about! 

Ok, this isn't just fried chicken. It's the best fried chicken! It's close to illegal because it's Killer good!!

As Arnold said, 'I'll be back' it gets a HUGE recommend!

Delicious breakfast/brunch spot. Service was slow, but the food was tasty. They do not have any indoor waiting space and the place is tiny, so keep this in mind if you go when it's really cold outside or rainy. They literally will make you wait outside in the rain for a table. We went on a Monday morning around 10am and had a 20 minute wait for a table of 4, in the rain and cold. We were from out of town and had an Uber drop us off so we waited because we didn't really have any other options. It's in the middle of a residential neighborhood.

First off, everyone that accompanied us tonight was nice and kind. The appetizers were pretty good, but not good enough to meet my standards. Then dinner came,  the only food that I like was the eel and rice, and the other food was fine. After dinner, we had deserts and it was really good.

Ordered lunch for takeout. Started with the croissant salmon sandwich a twist on bagels and lox and was decent. French onion soup tasted like salt water and the cheese was stringy and hard with bread pieces that were stale. Bacon egg and cheese sandwich and French toast croissant were good. The side of mashed potatoes smelled better than it tasted-was the size of one spoonful and was bland with no flavor. Disappointed in this experience.

Went here for dinner and the place was packed but still got our food in a reasonable time. Food was delicious!! Got the godfather strip cooked med rare and it was actually medium rare!! Fantastic job! I highly recommend trying there dinners. Also have been there for breakfasts and incredible! A must try.

Pho An Hoa is my neighborhood go-to place for Vietnamese food. I've been going since they first opened and I absolutely love it. It sits in a little plaza off the corner of Waters Ave and Habana Ave. They only close on Wednesdays ( fine with that ), and they are dine- in or carry out only. Trust me.. They're worth the drive over. Plus who has the funds for all them extra Uber Eats charges anyway? Let's talk staff. The staff is just the sweetest group of people I ever met. I'm not going to lie. I kinda want to ask if they will adopt me. Or at least invite me over for holidays. I'm fine with either. Ok, so the food. More importantly the pho. The pho is amazing! The broth is rich with flavors and they always have your extra add-ins on the side which is everything you need to customize your pho. I get the #18. Large. XLarge if you're extra "hangry". Then there are times, ladies and gentlemen, here in Tampa, where it's almost too hot to eat pho. I said "almost". Don't cancel me yet. So on days when I need something to cool me down a bit, I go for the Bún bowls. Vermicelli rice noodles, a chopped up egg roll, shredded carrots, cucumbers, and bean sprouts, beef (they also have shrimp or you can have both! #treatyoself) and served with nuoc cham sauce (fish sauce). It's lite and fresh, and perfect for days with a heat index of 103. I also can't resist getting their shrimp and pork spring rolls, and the egg rolls. And sometimes I share. 
  Also they are open at 9am so when I don't fee

We're visiting from California and My husband ordered the Escoveitched Red Snapper and the food is amazing. Nice and hot and seasoned to perfection l. Freida was such a sweetheart and had excellent customer service. We will be back.

All around bad. It's like they can't decide if they want to be a trendy chill spot to grab a drink and some appetizers with friends or a club. So the atmosphere is just really weird. The seating is uncomfortable and inadequate. The food and drinks aren't good (the shrimp on the surf and turf flatbread was gross) and it's all overpriced for what you get (the sangria has to be 90% fruit juice). They play obnoxious music with bumping bass at 7pm on Thursdays as well as 4pm on Sundays. I just don't get it. As a Channelside resident, I was very excited for them to go in and gave them a year to sort it all out. But all this time later, the whole place is just so disappointing. The staff are nice for whatever that's worth.

The beef Adobo was delicious.  The lumpia was also delicious. The halo halo was very good as well. The only suggestion I have is that the staff be more welcoming.  Not necessarily rude just kind of cold. Also could you use a lot more veggie sides. Cold salads perhaps. Fish saucy vinegary salads would be ideal. I will try again on a different day perhaps?

Living only a 2-3 min walk away I'm pretty damn excited this place opened! The space is cozy and well done. Servers and staff were friendly and quick to take care of you. The menu, while on the smaller size, is solid diner food, but you can tell made with love and care. Biscuits and gravy with house made sausage, nailed it! Bread pudding meets French toast, I hope it's added to the menu permanently. Coffee is straight forward good drip coffee. Nothing is in your face fancy, it's a diner!! But you can expect a relaxed feel and belly filling diner goodness.
Man the shrimp tacos were bomb and the drink and service from my girl jasmine were amazing  my family really enjoyed ourselves

As a Floridian I have been in many persian restaurants but mirage in  Clearwater as has so far the best food and employees,such lena,very sweet,friendly host also friendly atmosphere,good prices,good food and etc I'll give to this restaurant 5 stars,we will definitely come back from Fort Lauderdale again,
Probably in my 10+ years in Tampa I'd say this is the most authentic cuisine and dining experience. The sangria is a sure hit and the food is exceptional. A+ experience.
Food was amazing!  I got the one with the Nashville hot chicken in it.  Great atmosphere!!

I just want to put a disclaimer that I have only ever had the beignets here. That being said, my review is solely based on the beignets and the beignets alone.
Being as someone who has never been to New Orleans to have a traditional beignet, these beignets were pretty good by my standards. Now, if you've never had a beignet before (pronounced ben-yay), they are small pieces of fried dough with a very generous amount of confectioners sugar. The beignets from Shelly's Cafe are just that, with each beignet having its own mountain top of powdered sugar to go along with it. I've always ordered them for to-go, so I cannot vouch for their dine-in service, but the to-go service is pretty great. Everyone here is pretty nice and welcoming from what I've seen.
The cafe is located in a plaza, so parking is not terrible. You are able to park right in front of them, if they are not too busy and crowded.
Overall, I will continue getting the beignets from them, and will update my review if I come in to have their actual food for once!
After being on hold for 20 minutes was told they do not accept to go orders until after 7 pm (this was 5:30). Very disappointed. Called another restaurant.
Great patio and great food. Service was fantastic. Loved the cheese ravioli and ceaser salad!
The bacon Mac dog was very good.  Very friendly staff, will definitely go back to support this local small business.
Excellent Ethiopian fare. I had the chicken and I was impressed by the entire sprig of rosemary that they threw in there...the food packed with flavor.

Pequeño recuerdo con gran comida de puertorriqueña. Lo mejor es que la fritura te la comes recién hecha y no esta en vitrina. Si tienes prisa llama y haz tu orden. No te defraudara. Todavía puedo saborear la alcapurria recién cocida.También tienen sofrito y hacen comida para fiestas. Definitivamente volveré una y otra vez!!!

This place is a joke. Ordered ahead of time and went there to pick it up, A employee asked me what I am here to pick up. Provided my name and she goes, what is it. Food. 10 min later she hands me brown bag simultaneously with someone order. No name nothing on the bag. I asked what's the name on it. She goes "whatever the name.."

Fuck this store. I now know 12 of my colleague who eat out will NEVER go there. She was extremely rude and she does not belong in any places where customer service is necessary.

Our first visit here and all I can say is WOW! 
What a fantastic place this is!
To be clear, we in the STL metro area are spoiled! Why? Because we have multiple top notch independent bakeries that specialize in all sorts of pastries etc.
I remember being in two large cities in the west, not cities I was "lost" in, but cities I've been to multiple times. I have repeatedly tried to locate stand out bakeries similar to those we have in the STL area, and have repeatedly came up EMPTY!
Those few bakeries we have located are SO lacking when compared to the AMAZING Talent we take for granted in our area!
So we went to Nathaniel Reid on a Whim... and purchase 1 or 2 of items that caught our eye to "audition"  We were Stunned/Thrilled at just how good their products are. Some of the best I've EVER tasted, and given the long line of customers that assembled and the SOLID reviews both on Yelp and other review sites, it would appear many many others have discovered Nathaniel Reid's goodness as well! (Yet another independent thats quality and ability to think outside the box, has helped them rise above the damaging effects of the pandemic!)  Congrats To the owner and staff, You guys literally blew us away!

One comfort food that is a good to for me is fried chicken. I love me some good ol fashion salt and pepper, lightly battered friend chicken and this place has it (I love my Cajun from Popeyes but you know.. need to mix it up at times). 

My group and i ordered a whole bird since we had a group of 5 share and it made the most sense in terms of pricing. That being said, we had to wait for them to make it fresh and boy, was it worth the wait. Every bite has that nice crispy bite and the insides are done right. Is usually don't like the white meat but they got the chicken breast juicy on the inside and crunchy on the outside. 

The chicken itself is very good but they have a lot of sauces there as well. They spicy honey is really good and i stuck with that one cause it just adds a little kick but a sweetness that covers your mouth. 

The sides were ok; fries were well seasoned and lightly fried; the coleslaw in my opinion was nothing special. 

I think the place is a bit more pricey that your average chain but good to try if you're in the area and if you're a fan of fried chicken!

In china town, be my guest who's the best!   Wife picked this place and we went with it.  Ordered to go: 2 orders of the roast duck and pork platter, peeking duck roll, roast pork noodle soup, and chicken lo main. 

Every portion size is on point and enough to fill a grown adult.  Amongst 2 adults and 2 little kids we had left overs for friends at the park.  

Of note, you get a duck roll per order, so if you want 3, you need 3 orders.   And we didn't realize no wraps with the roast duck version we got so add that if you want. 

If you want soy sauce, etc ask for it as I assumed that's included std but it wasn't. 

If in the area we'd go back, but not out of our way.

Now I want to start off by saying that this place has one of the coolest decor and layout! I was in love with the attention to detail they put into the design and ambiance of both the upstairs and downstairs. It was stunning!!! 
The selection of liquor and beers were great as well and very fitting for the place. 
I docked off some stars, because our experience with the staff was not as great as the building. Since we spent most our time waiting... for food, drinks, .... everything.... we got to notice every detail of the this place. 
We spent more time waiting then we did drinking or eating. I could understand if the place was busy and they had many tables, but nope.... there were a few people at the bar and another couple upstairs with us. The rest of the place was empty, due to it being later in the evening. 
We will try it again when back in the area, because it's definitely worth trying and seeing.

Finally, I've found my sushi place in Santa Barbara. Now this isn't the best sushi I've had, but it's not trying to be either. It feel like a local mom/pop shop doing it right with their best. I've tried so many different sushi places in SB and they're all either way too expensive for the value or they are just bad. Edomasa hits the right medium of price and quality that it'll be my go to place now in SB. I got the deluxe sushi set with the edomasa roll for $32.50. The nigiri are actually real nigiri; the size, mold, fish, and rice are all how they're supposed to be. The fish taste clean and have their individual flavors. I was surprised at the quality of the uni given the overall price and other sushi items in the set. It was really good uni and could have easily ballooned the cost of the set. I also usually don't like imitation crab rolls, but the edomasa roll with the shrimp and sauce was very good! It's also huge to help to fill you up. I was very happy and satisfied with my meal and it seems like a nice place to drink/eat for happy hour once covid gets better.

A small town family operation that is well-deserving of its Main Street store front.  One of the best spots in town for a quick bite, always quick and fresh!  The falafel pita and smoothies are my go-to!
so slow. there are 5 cars ahead of me and  i have been here for atleast 10 minutes and only one has gotten their food. why am i here?

The food and drinks were absolutely delicious and the service was exceptional. I don't care to leave reviews too often but I took my BF here for a quick bday brunch and he had so many options which isn't usually the case as a vegetarian. We're both looking forward to returning and trying every bowl. Plus, the free cookies are a sweet touch.

Easy COVID lunch spot and easy to-go lunch. Quick service, restaurant is clean, staff are very attentive. The beef broth is some of the best I've had this side of the river. The spring rolls are hands down the best in New Orleans. Highly recommend.

Best Margaritas in Clearwater and possibly the whole damn Tampa/St. Pete area. You actually taste the Tequila unlike most of the places in this area and the rest of the ingredients mixes so well to create such a smooth taste. The food was just as good as well! Both dishes,  Chori Pollo & Chicken Chiles Rellenos, were amazing. Full of flavor and perfectly cooked. We found our new spot for when ever we are craving some Mexican Cuisine!

Completely obsessed with the duck fries! The only reason I gave it four stars and not five is the way it's set up in the second floor. You have to order everything from the bar and then seat yourself with no server service. Not a huge fan of this hipster nonsense. The second floor otherwise is really nice with games, a bar, seating area, and restroom.
Man!! I had the apple pancake and not only was it delicious, but it took me several days to finish!! Wonderful portions and a great selection of choices!! You won't be disappointed

I have never had an issue with here. My brother ordered food three hours ago and it never showed up. It shows you are open in Grubhub and it was over $50 worth a food. Let just say I'm very disappointed in how no one even reached out or answered the store phone when u tried calling I called 8 times. I live not even 5 minutes from there and we always order food because it is quick and the employees are very nice. I just wished they would have reached out to us to let us know so we could of done something else for food.

What a great restaurant! We had a fabulous meal there this week! Service was great, thanks to our excellent server Bill. I ordered the braised short rib and I literally repeated "wow" during my first few bites-it was amazing! My family also loved the scallops, the duck and the fish entree. 
Pleasant atmosphere- we had a private area with a  round table. Definitely one of Tampa's best restaurants!

On 4/23 enjoyed a Bayou burger and some onion rings as part of Williamson County Burger Week.  Burger was juicy and flavorful.  Rings were thick with a nice crunch.  As good as the food was, the people were terrific.  They were so positive and pleasant to interact with.  I have been a harsh critic of bad service at various restaurants in the past, but this was over the top great.  I appreciate their sincerity and effort.
Pretty good bar food & great service. The server was working very hard & still brought me refills before I even asked. Good value in the quantity of meals compared to price.

This place has got to be one of my most favorite local restaurants! The food is always on point and the service is too. I love the wedge salad with the filet medallions and the sweet golden beets. This is an entree salad that I dream about. And every other dish I've had from here has been amazing too, like the meatloaf, Salmon, etc.

Meh... Overall this place is just ok. As mentioned before the kitchen is very slow. We had a newly hired server. Despite that he was very pleasant and attentive. He also apologized for the slow food. In all we waited at least 45 min for our meal. My salad came out at that time too. I had the veal piccata. It wasn't a great cut with some fat but mostly it hadn't been hammered to thin it out at all. One piece was about a half inch thick.

I just moved to Tucson and came across this lovely coffee shop, I'm a big vibe person and all good vibes here, friendly people, great coffee and the owners are so sweet and friendly! They also serve beers at night that I haven't experienced yet but will be in the near future.

I love the atmosphere. Back ground music was 80's. I had the sea bass. Excellent. Our waiter could have been more attentive. He was very slow on refills and clearing plates. He often visited the table of ladies behind us. I think he was a little distracted.

We came here to try their homemade kimchi and left with a few more items than we expected. This is a really tidy and friendly Asian Market that carries a lot of different Asian products from food, snacks, fruits and veggies, drinks and alcohol. The food selection here was quite extensive in addition to their homemade kimchi they also had prepared meats like marinated bulgogi and fresh crab. Their fish prices were competitive to those at the fish market or grocery store. 

All in all their store is really organized and the employees were welcoming and helpful. This will be our new go-to for Asian food and drink. 

As other reviewers have said it is mostly a Korean and Japanese market, so you may not find what you are looking for if you are cooking Chinese.

Meh. Definitely a chill dive bar. So much potential! This is the oldest restaurant in Delaware. You'd think they would play that up and make it classy. Don't try and bring your kids - they are not allowed. I've never had bad food or drink here, but it's a bit slow. I like it for its history!

I've had an okay experience with honey grow. Every time I get their salads I'm disappointed for some reason, especially since their topping portions are so small. The price really adds up here and I don't think their portion size is worth it. Their stir fry is really good though so if you're gonna eat here, that's the way to go. They're currently doing curbside pick up which is great.

I went through the drive through and the customer service was really good! I ordered the spicy chicken sandwich deluxe, Mac n cheese meal with a lemonade and I asked very nicely for a ranch and chick-fil-a sauce. Once I got home I was super excited to eat the meal and once I opened the bag. BOTH SAUCES WERENT IN THE BAG! (Wasn't the biggest deal) I usually get this exact meal each time, but this time, it was gross. The Mac and cheese was only good on top once I kept eating it (giving it a chance) it tasted watery and not cheesy at all. Super bland. The sandwich was alright, the produce wasn't fresh you could definitely tell. The chicken was alright too, I think they overcooked it and I usually dip it in the sauces which I didn't unfortunately get. And the fries were just not great at all. And I was SUPER hungry which should say a lot. And I didn't even get to finish the meal. Overall I'll give it another try it's just pretty disappointing because I've been here so many times!

I just went in for the second time. First time was takeout, I decided to eat in today. And service was fantastic both times and the food is out of this world. I got one of their specials, cheese steak porgies and a order of gołabki. The porgies where great and possibility the best gołabki I've had to date. This is a cool spot to bring a few friends and eat family style. I plan to.

Wait is horrific here but they get you in and get you out after seating.  Food was good.  We had the lettuces wraps which were awesome.  The turkey burger was just ok and they ran out of chicken Mediterranean. My son likes the kids salmon.
This was a delivery and I don't recommend it. Took over three hours contacted them twice. And when it finally got here it was Luke warm and they forgot my fruit tea.
Ordered an Everything Pizza and must say, it is delicious! Some of the best pizza I've had! Definitely a must in Spring Hill!
Have been coming here for years but lately something has changed.  The food has become just "average" and the staff shows little interest in actually serving their customers. Sad.
Have ordered from here twice since the pandemic hit.  Both times the rolls were unforgivable.

This place is absolutely delicious  I was so excited to find "conveyor belt" sushi in the area, I haven't seen many in the US. The staff is also very courteous and we look forward to eating here again

I love this restaurant mainly just because of their fun decor and music. Service is okay but staff was friendly so it made up for it. My boyfriend and I ordered the fried calamari to start which came out fast and was very good(pictured). For an entree we got the spaghetti and meatballs to share(not pictured). The pasta was good and we got the meatballs on the side, but the dish needed a little more sauce. After asking the server she brought some over which was nice. The colossal brownie sundae is one of my favorite things to get whenever I come here because the brownies are usually super soft and warm and melt with the ice cream. When I ordered it this time some of the brownies were crunchy, so that disappointed me a bit. Overall good experience but only small things that weren't great.

Been here twice. Both times were a very very long wait to order then longer to get your food. Food is average. Last visit was yesterday (St. Patricks Day) at about noon. The woman that took our order had the worst attitude. Like we were a bother. Noticed she did that with several other patrons. Last time we will eat here.

Really enjoyed the experience with a great view from the second floor balcony, and a very friendly server! Mixed drinks were first class, and food was good. Would have been a 5 star, but a bit disappointed in the Truffle Crab Claws.  They looked impressive, but lacked on flavor, and had quite a bit of shell fragments that made them less than fun to eat.  I would go back for sure, but avoid the crab appetizer.

My husband and I were invited to Wolfsie's for a family member's 50th birthday. The  area is nice and right on the water. We had a nice size section and was seated promptly. The decor is ok, nothing special, typical bar but with a nice view. There was a love band there but we were not in a close enough area to see them. The  staff was very nice, efficient and quick. My husband and I ordered Long Islands and we were pleasantly surprised that they were strong! I ordered the classic Sirloin steak, well done with grilled onions and mashed potatoes. My husband ordered the tenderloin sandwich and fries. I have the restaurant 4 stars because the steak was a tad dry and I didn't get very onions on my steak. My husband raved about his v tenderloin and it was a nice size that he didn't even finish it all... I would definitely recommend Wolfsie's and plan on going back!

Little mix up with online order but the staff did a great job filling the order fast and efficiently.  Banana pancakes were delicious and they give you a huge serving.  Sausage was not too salty and very tasty. 
Chicken salad platter was a perfect helping of nicely season chicken salad and fresh perfectly ripped fruit. Will be back again soon. Quality and quantity were perfect.

This was one of our best experiences ever on vacation, the food, atmosphere & our waitress Caitlyn made this unforgettable. Amazing balance of flavors. It is fresh, clean food with the perfect portion size. Great cocktails and wines also. Definitely a must go to if your a foodie" like my husband and I it won't disappoint!!

Thank you Julia C for outstanding customer service on Saturday.
My dinner the blackened salmon special was amazing.  I think
it should be a regular on the menu. You have done a great job
during the circumstances and can't wait for you to open at 100%.

Thanks again to all of you!

Barbara
I ate breakfast this morning at BLT and had a Carnivore omelette. Delicious and filling. Excellent service.   Would eat there again.

I would give this place a million stars for sure.  Food is absolutely delicious.  The breakfast potatoes are the best I've ever had in a restaurant.  We will definitely make this a regular stop when visiting Nashville.

Food is delicious, staff is very friendly. Be prepared to hang out for a bit before being seated, but grab a drink and head into the little alcove while you wait. Adding this place to our local rotation!

love this place, came here pre-COVID and can't wait to come again. There's a cute little bakery in the front, but you can also order the pastries when you dine. We got the pastry basket to split -- probably not the best way to start the meal but it was fantastic! 

Also would love to raaave about the chai tea. I regret not ordering one for myself! So so good. For actual food, we got hummus and baba ganoush -- both so good & light. We also got the kafta kebab and zaatar flatbread. All super good - and very full by the end. Awesome food for a fantastic price!

Tacos, by no means authentic, but exactly what I would expect and not mad about it. I had the fish tacos and shrimp tacos and both had a good combination of flavors. We also tried the chips and guac which was my favorite part. The chips tasted fresh and homemade! We wanted to try some of the drinks but apparently their alcohol license was being renewed. The cashier was real polite and apologetic about it and gave us a free fountain drink and he also gave us free samples, so I would say they handles the situation pretty well. 

I would definitely swing by here again for some tacos.

Let me start first by saying I love this spot. I'm from North Jersey & live a good pastrami sandwich...on rye with spicy brown mustard and that is how I discovered the Kibitz Room once transitioning to the area 17 years ago...Now the bad news. 
I order the pastrami sandwich always...ALWAYS so I am very familiar with the taste and everything from this location. My daughter and I both ordered the whole pastrami sandwiches today, american cheese, spicy brown mustard, side of potato pancake at $18.00 a piece but usually WELL worth it. Today I received what seems to be boiled meat! I mean absolutely NO flavor, No spices Nothing. I'm a bit confused as to what happened since my last visit. It's like the pastrami was boiled for hours...not sure how pastrami is prepared but this was a bit perplexing! I mean no flavor at all. I thought wait...am I losing my sense of taste, NO, there is absolutely no flavor. I can't begin to imagine what could have caused this but I am so disappointed. Almost $60 spent and we can't eat either sandwich. 3 stars because I know how good these sandwiches usually are but today...NAH
Great menu. Good service. Large Outdoor patio. Checks all the boxes. Excellent pork chop. Excellent burger.

Let me say, walking into this location was an indicator of how my experience was going to be. There was trash and food in front of the door and there was no hostess dedicated at the front. I stood at the bar for over five minutes before being acknowledged.

I did a pick up order onli, the steak was EXTREMELY small (The pictures don't even do it any justice). My order was incomplete and missing items (shrimp and drink). When I asked the worker to switch my order, she (lady in a red shirt and braids) made a loud sigh and went to get the manager on duty. 

The manager, Cyn, said she could not refund or change my order because it was through a third party (although I made the order off of Friday's website). When I informed her that my order was missing items she replied saying "I can get you an order of shrimp if that's all you need. The manager not once apologized for missing items from my Togo order.
Wow. Just wow. This place NEVER disappoints. My family and I have been going here for years and I'm always beyond satisfied.

The general tso chicken was delicious- exactly what take out should taste like. Their authentic Chinese dishes are pretty good! I do wish their menu had some more description but everything has tasted good. Spring rolls were fine.

Very good, crispy bottom.   This pizza was delivered HOT.  The French fries were curly and were also delivered hot and crispy.     Medium bacon ranch pizza was filling and tasty, enough for two hungry adults but we also ordered a pepperoni pizza and that too was fresh!
Great margaritas, love the atmosphere. Tacos are delicious and salsa has some kick. Queso was on point. Staff was attentive to our party and very kind. Will do again.

This is the second time this year that I've met my friend D at FK for lunch. If this restaurant were closer, I'd be frequenting it a lot more. The food is healthy and the portions are generous. The staff and manager are friendly, efficient, and want to make sure everything is good - or they'll fix it. 

When you get in the door - and it can be a wait since this is a popular place - you order your bowl with 3 or more proteins, base and veggies. As your bowl is passed down the line, first with a base, you add veggies, protein, sauces, and add ins. I'm simple - spinach base, with broccoli and grilled chicken. I like the coconut sauce. 

Both of us enjoyed our bowls, sitting and talking outside on the patio. You can sit inside too. CDC guidelines are followed during the pandemic: social distancing and masks are required. Hand sanitizer is readily available. I love this place!

"WOW"
The Steaks are "Phenomenal" I'm still thinking about my Filet Mignon.

Had dinner reservations here on Saturday evening it was our first outside dining experience here at the Capital Grille.

You receive a wonderful Bread Basket served with butter. The Bread and Rolls where warm and tasty.

We started with the Oysters -- Unfortunately they where a miss too sandy.

Filet Mignon with Cipollini Onions, Wild Mushrooms with fig essence drizzled on top. -- 
This was Phenomenal the steak was perfectly cooked and seasoned, the crust was amazing and the center nice and juicy. The wild mushrooms where a dream, nutty earthy and tasty with Cipollini onions they where a perfect match with the fig reduction.
I ordered mine whole not sliced since I enjoy that better than a pre cut steak.

This is one of the top "3 Steaks" I have ever had at a restaurant.

Dry Aged NY Strip au Poivre with Courvoisier Cream-- 
The Steak was perfectly cooked and had a peppercorn crust that was also in the Courvoisier Cream sauce so tasty. Husband loved it he was very happy.

Grilled Asparagus--
They where way overcooked, they should have been firmer, would not order these again.

I would highly recommend the Wild Mushrooms as a side dish they are a dream just amazing.

For Dessert we tried the Brulee Cheese Cake --
The Cheese Cake was yummy and the Brulee crust made it extra special.
The fruit sauce and fresh berries gave it a good balance and freshness.

Overall the Meal was wonderful, we had great serv

drove 50 minutes on a Tuesday to have dim sum in tampa. only to be told at 2:28 that although they are still open we can only order Togo. craziness. i am a chef. i have never turned business away. Is your restaurant doing so well you didn't want my $100? I WILL NEVER EAT HERE AGAIN!

Superb family brunch! We were greeted by Victor with a friendly fsmile and were sat at an outdoor table with ocean view. The breakfast buffet, as well as the lunch menu was fresh and delicious, and the service was impressive. Troy was very kind, professional and made sure we were completely satisfied at all times. It was a beautiful, calm environment with a sense of teamwork from the staff. Keep up the great work Ocean Hai!

This location is gross. I took my kids for dinner and to play. Walk in and first thing I notice is the floors are sticky and not swept. Go to order and the staff is playing around and messing with each other and there is food behind the counter that has been stepped on and dragged around. I let my kids in the play area and the smell is so bad I have to walk out immediately. There is trash and crumbs on the floor in there as well. All of the soda machines and areas around them need to be wiped down. The windows and chairs are filthy with handprints and grime. We go to use the restroom and there was only one roll of toilet paper left and trash coming out of the trash cans. My final straw was the giant chunk of hair under the door. Only positive is that the food came quick and the staff was kind.

Great price. Great portions. And most importantly to me, the orange chicken and the general chicken was still crispy after they sauced it! I never go back to a place if the chicken breading is soggy. Overall I can't wait to go back! Also the general chicken is extremely good. And the beef chow mein was amazing too.
Great sandwiches and friendly employees. 4/5 stars due to understaffing and lack of seating.

First time going and really enjoyed this place. The atmosphere is different in a good way. Sat upstairs and they had Sinatra playing which I thought was cool. We went for grilled cheese Monday. Worth checking out. Service was great and friendly.

My partner and I picked this place for our Sunday brunch on our vacation to New Orleans from Austin.
We were seeking the 'classic' New Orleans white table cloth experience and this was talked up as such by reviews and numerous publications.

TL;DR

Overall this was the worst $100 meal I've ever had. It was especially disappointing since we wasted a prime eating opportunity on Antoines with so many other good choices
nearby.


The experience started with a queue at the hostess stand where there was obvious confusion on the part of the staff, and audible complaints about tables of seated guests.

Additionally, we dressed up expecting the described dress code, but were immediately greeted in the entry way dining area by the sight of guests wearing t-shirts and baseball caps. So much for enforcing a dress code. This really left a sour taste in my mouth as this was supposed to be a special experience and we took time to look nice which is not something we do every day.

Once seated in rickety chairs in the dark main dining room , we waited 15 minutes before we finally had to flag down somebody on the wait staff to get water.
The place settings were set inconsistently with my side having 2 knives and my partner's having only one.

When the waiter finally did come around, he was brusque and condescending.

We ordered the classic Oysters Rockefeller and broccoli with hollindaise as an appetizer.  Only the oysters came.  They were covered in a dark green paste, and were not as hot as

This was my second time here. The first time was a disaster, so to be fair, I attempted one more time. Besides, where else in Florida can someone get a California Burrito?
 I ordered a lot from the menu, mostly to give my fellow Yelpers a good look at their selection. I ordered a California Burrito with Carne Asada, grouper tacos and Cali Fries. Like other reviews, the Cali burrito was lighter on the meat than what I was used to in California, but was very much the same flavor as the west coast selection. The grouper tacos? The best on the East Coast so far that I have tried. The cali fries were awesome.
 All this is a must try if in the area. I gave them 4 stars only because they were stingy with the meat I the burrito.
Had the Jambalaya with Gumbo. I highly recommend it. Cathy's Kitchen is a must try if you're near St Louis airport.

The Waitresses tonight were unusually rude and disrespectful. I accidentally spilled a sparkling water, and immediately afterwards the waitress made an announcement to our entire party (a business fraternity event) about being appropriate. Our party did not deserve this attack, and the attack in itself made it so people would not believe in our organization.

Overall, this has been the worst dining experience I've had in a very very very long time. My friend and I made reservations for a Sunday brunch after seeing postings on Instagram that showcased delicious photos of food, drinks and the unique look of the place. It took over 5 minutes for someone to acknowledge/say hi after I arrived and standing by the reception area. Not all of the tables were occupied due to Covid, yet it would be courteous to just acknowledged that I'm waiting, as I can see two wait staff working. Then things got worse as it took over 40 minutes to get what we thought was an anticipated Belgian waffle for the tag price, and yet we received the most plain waffle with a side of fruit cup and maple syrup. We thought this was a joke! We waited over 40 minutes for something that we can make ourselves at home for a fraction of what it's worth at this restaurant. The silver lining (which the 1 star represent) of this visit is our waiter who took it upon himself to compensate our drinks, a he can see how disappointed we were.  Our intention is to support local business as much as we can during Covid, yet it's also fair for us to get the best value of quality and service.

I really like this food. I have dined-in three times and loved almost everything. The prices are a bit high but it is a trendy place downtown. 

This is a small counter service place. There are a few tables inside. It is in the lobby of an office building. They do have a separate entrance, which is nice. I have tried a variety of their empanadas and liked them all. I have tried a few of the sides and my favorites were the rice and lentils. I like them mixed together.

I know they have a small space, maybe this is why so many containers/cups are disposable? I wish eating here felt a bit more environmentally friendly. Although, now with COVID that is unlikely to change. 

In general, the service has been fine. On my last dine-in visit I was with my parents (from out-of-town) and we were given a tasty little dessert, yummy. 

However, I had take-out (5/13/20), and I had a strange experience. The take-out might keep me away for a bit, at least until the dining area is open again. 

I ordered an empanada combo to go, this is what I came in for. Then I noticed a sign for Honduran tamales. I had super good banana leaf wrapped tamales in Mexico, so I am always up for trying these tamales when I see them. I asked if I could add two to my to-go order. I was told they were only sold as lunch combos with jicama slaw. The person taking my order did ask someone on the back, which I appreciate. In the spirit of supporting local I said I would still take the tamales. I came in for one lunch
This is by far my favorite Thai food restaurant.  The best most subtle tastes, rich and satisfying.  I've been all over the menu and will continue to explore.  They are the wonderful.

I've lived in Antioch for five months and regret not finding this place sooner. 

Expansive menu, everything is delicious. Super nice people and allergen friendly. 

Tortillas made in house and soooo good. 

Will be back. A lot...

We've been here before because we are locals. Sometimes we stay out at the beach for a weekend and when we do, we have gone here to watch sports and have some wings. 

I've never had any issues with this location as far as service or food. I have to say that I am reviewing this time and giving them a 4 because I think they do a good job with their social distancing of tables, cleaning, masking of staff, etc. 

Our server was great, didn't come around too much or too little, our food came out hot and correct. The staff tuned the tvs to the channel of the Lightning game for us. No complaints at all... in fact we went to dinner at an upscale place the following night and it sucked. Should have gone back to Hooters, lol

Ran into this place while getting some food from next door. Have to say, good stuff! We tried their Cheesy mango drink and the Messy dragon fruit drink. Cheesy mango was interesting, very light, not overly sweet mango flavored drink, the cheese gives it a nice salty/sweet balance. Messy Dragon fruit drink was underwhelming, didn't really taste like anything, not even sweet. Felt like we were drinking water-down lightly sweet milk. It wasn't bad by any means, but the taste was aggressively bland. Over all good experiences, will definitely be back!

My friend and I ate a late breakfast at Cafe with Soul this morning. The waitress greeted her by name. How welcoming. My first time visit but not my last. She told me, "This is like your grandmother's cooking," and she was not wrong. Well, maybe better...definitely homemade and delicious. I had a spinach and cheddar omelet with home fries and rye toast that was perfect. Coffee was hot and enjoyable to drink black. I ended up tipping more than I usually do, because our bill was so low. Doylestown can really use a diner like this one! Plus, I love that it is a nonprofit that benefits music education. A win-win in my book.

These are some of the best biscuits I have ever eaten. The biscuits and gravy are out of this world, especially the portobello mushroom veggie gravy. Be sure to check the board for the daily specials as they are usually delicious. Friendly staff, moderate to mildly pricy but the biscuits are worth it!
Great experience in this new location! Friendly staff and great food. Food was fresh and shake was cold :) We are in trouble as this CFA is within walking distance.

Gross! I ate at the location in Reno, NV while on a weekend vacation, and was not happy at all! Expensive nasty, burnt food! Maybe they need cooking classes. Take my word, "Go somewhere else to eat Bar-B-Que!"

Still craving this pizza and haven't found a pizza joint out here in Vegas that has been able to deliver on a good gluten-free crust. So I'm boosting this rating to 5 stars.  When the pandemic is over and I'm able to get back to Tampa, I'll be stopping by. Hang in there Sally O'Neals.
A fairly good speakeasy. Not the most knowledgeable bartenders but very qualified in what they do. Looks like they're expanding into another area which should make the speakeasy much more attractive.

This place should not be overlooked. I come here often with my dad and everytime we order pizza. This pizza is one of the best in the area, hands down. It's on the thinner side, red sauce is delicious, cheese goopy, and I love how they cut it in smaller slices. The pasta meals are also very good - I usually get vodka or alfredo and both are tasty. Staff are always friendly and know my dad and I by name. This is definitely a place were a lot of locals have been going for years and is really a gem in Bristol. Highly recommend coming here!

We were kidless for the first time in 5 months and sat at the bar to feel like adults. Christian was our bartender/server. He was busy but attentive. We learned a little about him and genuinely enjoyed ourselves. He is a top notch bartender and we had a great time!
Fantastic little pizza shop. Only tried it a few times and the food has been great. Will keep coming back.

Great, fresh food and friendly service. Portions don't *look* huge but they're hearty and delicious -- you won't go home hungry. I was really glad to find that they had fatteh: grilled meat (or felafel) over rice and fried pita chips with a yogurt tahini sauce. I hadn't had any in years and their version is fantastic. Had chicken shawarma and baba ghanouj on a later visit, which didn't disappoint. 

Two things I love: 1) $1 "mini" sides. I'm accustomed to Middle Eastern restaurants charging $3-5 for a side of mezze like hummus, baba, and so forth. Damas charges just $1 for a nice side of any of their mezze specialties, and it's great to get a nice little portion of stuff for a modest price. 2) You can swap out rice in an entree for grilled veggies if you're doing low-carb or just not feeling rice that day.
Yummy. Cool atmosphere. Not a big enough food selection. I will come back again next Spring to see what has changed.

We walked from Broadway.  It's not too far but a little hard to walk right now with all the construction since some of the sidewalks are closed.  The place is cute inside and it wasn't crowded.  We sat on the second floor in the back.  The service was a little slow to get started but as some of the other tables cleared out our server was very attentive.

We started with the Tequila Mockingbird, a mezcal Margarita with egg white.  It was very smooth and smokey.  We loved the Tatchos, which are basically Tater Tot nachos. The Brussels sprouts were with blueberry jam were delicious.  I had the roasted duck breast with the faro peach salad.  For me, it was just okay. My friend had the beef short ribs barbacoa and loved them. If you go, definitely get the Tatchos to share.

I've been wanting to try this place but the hours are limited. Finally had a day where I could get the time to go for lunch! I had the gator and crawfish sausage. Both were very good, perfect mix of spice and full of flavor! My daughter had the crab cakes which were freshly made not the frozen kind! The restaurant is like a food truck turned into restaurant so all seating is out doors! The parking is limited. Definitely great food, great little outdoors seating and veteran owned! Definitely will be visiting again!!!

We rented out the lounge area for a retirement party, and were very happy with the service, food and drink. We had about 20 people in our group, it could have easily fit 20 more. The seating was a little awkward for the group to be together(like a baby shower), it's better designed for groups that would mingle in smaller groups(networking or work related). 

The waitress was very attentive, we were never lacking food or drink. The atmosphere and decorating were modern. The only complaint is that It was a little loud since we were right next to the bar. 

I ordered the apple martini, which was a little too strong for my taste. However the white dessert wines we ordered (I can't remember the names) were absolutely delicious!

Came here for AYCE KBBQ on a weekday night and we were seated right away. We went with the more expensive option ($34.95 per person) that has a lot more meat choices, and we do not regret it! The Sam Gup Sal and Gal Bi - Chicken were the table's favorites!

Overall the KBBQ has the standard items but also covered a few others I haven't seen in other places! Everything was flavorful and delicious, and I really enjoyed all the meat that we ordered. However, I was a bit upset by the portion sizes because it kept changing. Our first time ordering the Gal Bi - Chicken, we got two long strips of chicken. We knew we could handle that so we ordered another one as a last hurrah, and this time we got 4 or 5 long strips of chicken. We all felt flustered and bamboozled because we were already so full and just wanted a small portion of chicken each as dessert.

In the end, I of course championed the table and finished most of the chicken. It was delish.

We celebrated my 9 year old son's birthday tonight and asked what he wanted for dinner.  Spiros of course!  It's a family favorite.  Everything is always fantastic!  Love that they're doing curbside right now!  Dinner from Spiros is a must!

I've ordered from here before and it's great food. However, I really feel the need to talk about customer service. I ordered again tonight through Grubhub. I was notified that my order was delayed, no big deal. What I DIDNT expect was a call from the restaurant saying my order has been completed for "quite some time but Grubhub hasn't assigned a driver and we apologize for your wait". Ok, if that isn't going above and beyond for customer service, I don't know what is! Awesome folks and great food. You got my vote Blind Pig! Go eat Blind Pig folks. You're appreciated there!

We have loved this place for years. Unfortunately it has very poor management. We all know if you don't have a good manager the rest of the staff will also not care. I've given them multiple passes due to the current situation. They do have good food. The cheese spaetzle and jagerschnitzel  are delicious if you can get it. We ordered once and they forgot the gravy for the schnitzel.  Once we ended up with the wrong sides. A couple weeks ago they forgot to turn our order in. The owner is constantly online asking people to please support his business. Every time I try his poorly trained staff makes it impossible. As you see I've previously left multiple raving reviews of this place. While I can excuse small issues due to suppliers etc. those things I can't blame on the restaurant. The fact that their staff does not have the ability to run the business is a definite issue. My last straw was calling in to place an order. They said hold please. They placed the phone down but never properly placed it on hold. I could hear everything going on in the store. They were talking, laughing, just totally ignoring a customer. I actually waited 15 mins and had my husband try to call in from his phone. Of course it went to VM because the staff didn't know how to properly place a call on hold. I eventually hung up but could not call back. So, when the restaurant goes under or the staff complain they are making no money, remember it was their own fault. I personally recommend 2 other German res

Fantastic fancy beignets, so much better than plain flavorless beignets any day.  I like the king cake one the best, it tasted like there was cream cheese in it. The matcha is decent too.  
he ordering process is inefficient and gets a minus 1 star.  You have to be patient to order but I still think it's worth it though.  There is 1 person who takes the order and this same person also makes all the coffee drinks, therefore the line move very slowly.  There's no table service.  Order at the end of the bar at the rear of the restaurant.  Vanilla latte was good and goes great with the beignets.

This was the best meal I've had in quarantine so far! It was delicious, reasonably priced, and travelled well. There's not much more you can ask for when it comes to a to go meal. 

We ordered the special of the night which was crawfish pasta with fried shrimp on it. It was incredibly flavorful and came with corn and bread on the side. We also ordered the seafood extravaganza which came with your choice of blackened fish and shrimp with crawfish cheese fries. We ordered our seafood blackened and it was so tasty. I loved the crawfish cheese fries too. It was truly a perfect meal that made my entire week better. 

This was my first time trying Heard Dat kitchen and definitely won't be my last. If you haven't ordered from here yet you need to! All the food was still hot when we got it and tasted as good as if we ate it there. We picked it up but they are also on Uber eats!
Great Chinese food for a great price. I always get the lunch special and am able to eat on it twice.

Burgers were very good. Great service. We got our food very fast. I did not like the homemade ketchup. It was to sweet for my taste. Lind of tasted like a sweet spaghetti sauce. It would be great on cheese sticks. Will go back again.

Amazing as always. Since we were in the Metairie area we decided to try this location.  Normally we go to the French Quarter location. This place was busy with a 25min wait. So we waited of course! We got our favorite food, Chargrilled oysters and a couple of drinks.  Might I highly recommend the coconut cucumber margarita...omg! Freaking amazing! I know this post is short and sweet but I mean,, c'mon, its Acme. They rock!
Took my family from the suburbs here. They loved it! The plates are big portions so you could try a lot of things and then split that for dinner. Low key vibes and byob.

Staff quick to seat patrons, used all recommended safety measures. Ordered a waffle and hash browns. Hash browns were cooked to the specific way I ordered them, waffle was ok. Restaurant was clean and the staff was courteous.
Cute little bake shop with delectable food and a very friendly staff. Bought the honey lavender cake for myself and it did not disappoint. Would recommend to everyone for a lux cake.

Service is horrible.  We had to ask for everything that should have been brought out before before our food came or at least when the food came out. Like no silverware or plates for appetizer. When I asked for silverware was brought out plastic because they had none real silverware clean( this is what we were told). I ordered snow crabs and had to ask for crackers to open the crabs with was told they didn't have any.  Our drinks were never refilled.  One order didn't have all the food that was supposed to come with the it.  I spoke to the manager and the only thing that came of that was the server NEVER returned to our table.  A new waitress came and brought us the bill that we had to wait 15 minutes for.  I will never return to this place.

Loved our waiter Tim- he was friendly, personable and great.

The big issue I have is that there is no smoking even outside sitting but there's no consequences to people who smoke and you can smell it from where you're sitting. They need to do a better job controlling the customers who smoke  to make sure that they don't.
Absolutely the best tacos I've had. The el pastor and carne asada tacos are amazing. I love the pickled veggies they have for people to take. It gets busy around lunch time, but we'll worth the wait.

I reviewed Sushi Express on episode 39 of the Just Grubbin podcast at the 12:47 mark. I can't even front, this place caught me totally by surprise. In a good way. Like when you get fries from Burger King and you notice they slipped a onion ring in there. It's the little things, anyway I digress. The reason it caught me by surprise was because it's located in a small strip mall but that's what I get for judging a book by it's cover. Shame on you Lauren. No lie I drove by this place no less than 50 times, and finally stopped after I read the great Yelp reviews. Once again Yelp didn't let me down.

I walked in on a Friday night and they had business BOOMING, I called ahead of time and still had to wait 15 minutes. Some people look at this as a a bad thing, I look at it like this...if their that busy that means the food is going to be worth it more times then not. And buddy It was definitely well worth the wait. Every roll I tried was delicious and fresh and the shumai was perfect. They'll be seeing me again very soon.
great atmosphere and decor. and really good music. Attentive staff and quick service. Masa crusted shrimp were perfect. Great for lunch or a double date.
Jimmy and Ed make Karla's extra special.  The food is excellent and the drinks are well made.

Yup! That was incredible. The atmosphere is quaint and homey, the food was beautifully prepared, the woman who runs the place is upbeat and smiley.  She seems to do everything, and you've got to respect that. I never felt neglected. I feel I love with the place. Anyone leaving a 1 star review of this place is clearly deranged. I'll be back.

Wonderful place to stay during a visit to NOLA!

Great location in the French Quarter.  In easy walking distance to everything: restaurants, shopping, bars.  

Room was large and comfortable, with free water bottles daily; free WiFi; and a great free breakfast with scrambled eggs, grits, sausage, bacon, fresh orange juice, coffee, pancakes, etc, etc.  We also got free vouchers to have one drink each in their bar, Vive!

Tip:  Ask for a room facing the hotel's courtyard.  We had one, and you could still hear Bourbon Street until 2 am nightly, but quieter than the rooms facing the street.

This place was across from out hotel so we ate here twice.  Both times we sat at the bar.  Both times I had a sandwich for breakfast.  

The rubin = amazing 
The chicken sandwich = meh - the piece of fried chicken could have been bigger.  

The place gets mobbed so go early.
Love the pizza! Great service, friendly and respectful staff. Good value! A little dark in there for my taste but we will be back.
Excellent chicken parm and great service, also very fast service.  Prices are very good and atmosphere is good.  Like the BYOB option.
